source: The Big Lead: How to access the Pirate Shop (Nov 1, 2026)
text:
Fortnite Treasure Hunters is the theme of the new season, and within that, the usual in-game loot chests have changed slightly. Whenever you open a chest, there is a chance that, instead of the normal loot pool, you'll roll a Treasure Hunt prize.
On top of that, if you're in a squad and someone on your team opens a chest and gets the Pirate Token, all squad members will get it too.
Put simply, the Pirate Shop is the regular Fortnite item shop, except every item in it is free. Yes, completely free, letting you claim anything in it you want. All skins, emotes, cosmetics, kicks, and so on: you can just click on them, claim them, and add them to your account, and yes, you keep the items forever.
Once claimed, this will last for 14 days before the shop reverts to normal and you'll need to start paying for stuff again. There are a few exceptions, namely: Real-money offers (rather than things that cost V-Bucks), Gifts, Battle Pass levels, or Sidekicks you already own, but aside from that, everything is completely free for the taking.
